title: Real Madrid managers in order
brief: Name Real Madrid's last ten permanent managers in order up to the end of 2025/26, from Jose Mourinho's first spell in 2010. The label is the year each spell began.
period: Real Madrid managers, May 2010 to May 2026

notes.Vicente del Bosque: Vicente del Bosque was in charge from 1999 to 2003, before this board starts.
notes.Carlos Queiroz: Carlos Queiroz (2003/04) is before this board starts.
notes.Jose Antonio Camacho: Jose Antonio Camacho (2004) is before this board starts.
notes.Mariano Garcia Remon: Mariano Garcia Remon (2004) is before this board starts.
notes.Vanderlei Luxemburgo: Vanderlei Luxemburgo (2004 to 2005) is before this board starts.
notes.Juan Ramon Lopez Caro: Juan Ramon Lopez Caro (2005/06) is before this board starts.
notes.Fabio Capello: Fabio Capello (2006/07) is before this board starts.
notes.Bernd Schuster: Bernd Schuster (2007 to 2008) is before this board starts.
notes.Juande Ramos: Juande Ramos (2008/09) is before this board starts.
notes.Manuel Pellegrini: Manuel Pellegrini (2009/10) is before this board starts.

checks: Every spell and its start date agrees between Wikipedia's list of Real Madrid managers (correct to 16 September 2026) and Transfermarkt's staff history. Since 2000 there have been 21 spells (Del Bosque to Mourinho's return), so the board takes the ten most recent, starting with Ancelotti in June 2013 (Mourinho's first spell, 2010 to 2013, is just before it). Ancelotti and Zidane each fill two places. Santiago Solari began as caretaker on 29 October 2018 and was made permanent on 13 November 2018 (Transfermarkt shows the two parts); it is one spell. Alvaro Arbeloa was named head coach on 12 January 2026 after Xabi Alonso left, and both sources list him as a full manager, not a caretaker. Jose Mourinho returned on 11 June 2026. No caretaker was needed to make ten. Mourinho's return in June 2026 is after the end of 2025/26, so it isn't counted (Tenaball's cut-off); his 2010 to 2013 spell fills the first place instead.
